verdict.rationale: monday.com's own marketing says developers can use its APIs and SDKs to build custom apps. It also documents a code-first apps framework and Vibe, an open-source React component library. The SDK claim is a single marketing line, though: no specific SDK packages, supported languages or SDK reference docs are evidenced. Missing for 10: named official SDKs and their supported languages, SDK reference documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
